name: research-analytics-team
description: Team-orchestration expert package on the dmr credibility core (T1-T4 source grading, >=2/3-source cross-validation, templates A-E) + WorkBuddy connectors (patsnap/westock/github/canva, tyc-mcp if connected) + budget governor / two-phase source pool / run-manifest / pause-line takeover (timeout -> snapshot -> pending-takeover, 3-branch adjudication). The portable SKILL.md is a platform asset-routing annex, not a research entry.

displayDescription.en: End-to-end market/competitor/industry research delivering source-graded, cross-validated, confidence-labeled, reproducible reports.
displayDescription.zh: 集大成调研分析团队：以源分级与交叉验证为内核，交付带置信度、可复现的行业/竞品/市场深度报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 调研 [行业/赛道] 的竞争格局、产业链与 1-2 年趋势，并给出商业化避坑建议
defaultInitPrompt.en: Research the competitive landscape, value chain, and 1-2 year trends of [industry/track], with commercialization pitfalls.
